get.description:
The graph under a root as nodes and edges, for the graph view. The root is `place_id`
with every place under it, or the country's top place. `kinds` says which kinds come back,
every kind by default; the other filters keep the matching places and institutions, and the
root is always kept. With `governments`, the only institutions are the places' governments.
Rejected entities come back only when asked for by `status`, and platform domains only with
`platforms`. Over a few thousand nodes the payload is cut down to the places and their
governments, and says so. Each node carries what lies beneath it and its coverage, and the
payload the root's ancestors, for the breadcrumb.

AssignmentStatus.title: AssignmentStatus
AssignmentStatus.description: The lifecycle: is it still going.

CountryOutput.title: CountryOutput
CountryOutput.description:
One country's five tables, as the console reads them. The global type tables have routes
of their own.

changes.title: Changes
changes.description: Each entity whose status would change, in the order the decision changes it.

run.description: The run the work would start in; null when no run would take it.

DecisionPreviewOutput.title: DecisionPreviewOutput
DecisionPreviewOutput.description: What a decision would do, from the decision run and rolled back.

EnteredBy.title: EnteredBy
EnteredBy.description: How a row got here. On every entity and every evidence row.

suggested_type.title: Suggested Type
suggested_type.description: The type a body saved as `other` would have.

place.description: An institution's place, or a place's parent.

owner.description: The institution a homepage or source belongs to, or that a domain's question is about.

url.title: Url
url.description: A homepage's or a source's page.

EntitySummaryOutput.title: EntitySummaryOutput
EntitySummaryOutput.description: What to compare an entity by; a field that does not apply to its kind is null or empty.

EvalEntry.title: EvalEntry
EvalEntry.description:
One judged thing (`scorer.Entry`): a hit, a miss, a false positive, or `wrong` (saved,
but not what the dataset expects: a miss and a false positive at once). The bucket says
why it counts as it does; the group is what it is (an institution or source type, or
`parent`, `homepage`, `domain`).

snapshot_url.title: Snapshot Url
snapshot_url.description: A short-lived download link to the stored page or file; null once pruned.

FindingOutput.title: FindingOutput
FindingOutput.description: One thing the assignment saved, with the quote it gave for it.

GateOutput.title: GateOutput
GateOutput.description:
A pilot target the run is judged on: a recall floor on one assignment type. Hits and
misses are null when the run was not judged on it: still running, or recorded before
gates were kept, in which case the floor is today's. The verdict is null when there was
nothing to judge.

GraphAncestor.title: GraphAncestor
GraphAncestor.description: A place above the root, for the breadcrumb.

GraphEdge.title: GraphEdge
GraphEdge.description: A link between two nodes, from the row that holds the key to the row it points at.

GraphNode.title: GraphNode
GraphNode.description:
One entity as the graph view draws it: what to call it, its kind and status, and the
figure its size follows.

truncated.title: Truncated
truncated.description: True when the whole graph was over the cap and only the places and their governments came back; the client expands a place or an institution on demand.

HomepageOutput.title: HomepageOutput
HomepageOutput.description: A homepage claim: every claim an institution made, verified or not.

InstitutionOutput.title: InstitutionOutput
InstitutionOutput.description: An institution as the table lists it.

item_ids.title: Item Ids
item_ids.description: Decide these open items of the kind, the ones the reviewer saw; else all.

item_ids.title: Item Ids
item_ids.description: Decide these open items of the kind, the ones the reviewer saw; else all.

NamePatternCheck.title: NamePatternCheck
NamePatternCheck.description:
A name pattern tried on the country's institutions of a type. An invalid pattern is an
answer, not a failed request: the console shows `error` as the pattern is typed.

NamingPreview.title: NamingPreview
NamingPreview.description: How the rules read one name.

NamingPreviewInput.title: NamingPreviewInput
NamingPreviewInput.description: Rules as the form holds them, saved or not, and the names to read with them.

NamingRules.title: NamingRules
NamingRules.description:
How the country writes its public bodies' names, in its languages. A government's name is
a place name with a designator around it ("Township of Elmwood", "Elmwood, Township of");
knowing the designators lets the checks find the place name and tell a township from the
city of the same name.

PlannedOutput.title: PlannedOutput
PlannedOutput.description: Work a decision asks for. `skipped` says why it would not start; null when it would.

ProcurementHandledBy.title: ProcurementHandledBy
ProcurementHandledBy.description: Whether an institution buys on its own account or its parent buys for it.

Progress.title: Progress
Progress.description: How far a run has got and what it has spent.

RelatedOutput.title: RelatedOutput
RelatedOutput.description: An entity the question names, under the fact that names it, such as `duplicate_of`.

ReleaseInput.title: ReleaseInput
ReleaseInput.description: Which held assignments to queue: a few at a time by default.

related.title: Related
related.description: Every entity the question names by id.

same_kind_open.title: Same Kind Open
same_kind_open.description: The other open items that ask the same question.

started_since.title: Started Since
started_since.description: The assignments on the entity or its institution made since the decision.

next_open_id.title: Next Open Id
next_open_id.description: The open item to look at next: another of the same question first, else the one raised before this, as the queue lists them.

ReviewMember.title: ReviewMember
ReviewMember.description: An item of a queue row, with what to recognise its entity by.

question.title: Question
question.description: The facts every item has, reasons aside.

count.title: Count
count.description: The row's items that match the filters.

raised_at.title: Raised At
raised_at.description: When the first item was raised.

decided_at.title: Decided At
decided_at.description: When the last item was decided.

item_ids.title: Item Ids
item_ids.description: Every item of the row, to decide them by.

ReviewRow.title: ReviewRow
ReviewRow.description:
A line of the queue: an item on its own, or every item of one `kind` and status, which
ask the same question and are decided together.

RunFilter.title: RunFilter
RunFilter.description:
What a run works on (spec section 7.1). An empty list is no restriction. The levels and
types bound the subjects a run seeds itself with and every assignment it spawns; the subject
ids name the places and institutions it starts from, and spawned work descends from them.

SpawnOutput.title: SpawnOutput
SpawnOutput.description: Work the decision asks for; the assignments module queues it.

SubjectOutput.title: SubjectOutput
SubjectOutput.description: The place or institution an assignment works on, by name.

TypeSummary.title: TypeSummary
TypeSummary.description:
One assignment type's scores over the subjects of a run: how many subjects were judged
on it, the mean of their recall and precision (unweighted: each subject counts once), and
the entries summed over them (hits null when no score kept them).
